resources.string: Put a shortcut from an app, such as a contact\'s direct dial, a bookmark or a settings page, in the quick launcher\'s results.
Only the home screen app can read the shortcuts already on your home screen, so add the ones you want here once. Pick an app below and choose the shortcut in its own screen.
No app on this phone offers shortcuts to add.
This app\'s shortcut can only be opened from the home screen.
A script in ~/.shortcuts, run as Termux:Widget runs it: those in tasks in the background, the others in a terminal.
Termux needs allow-external-apps = true in ~/.termux/termux.properties (then restart Termux), and Flux Titan Hub needs permission to run commands in Termux.
Flux Keyboard adds New message, New note, Compose email and Search to the quick launcher for the apps it knows, where the app accepts them.
Flux Keyboard\'s shortcuts for this app
Your Termux:Widget scripts and tasks (~/.shortcuts) in the quick launcher, kept up to date. Needs allow-external-apps = true in ~/.termux/termux.properties and permission to run commands in Termux.
